get.summary: Health of the API, database and background services

post.summary: Sign in with e-mail and password; sets the session cookie
Re-enter the password to allow sensitive actions for 5 minutes

get.summary: The current session (user, CSRF token, timeouts), or 401

post.summary: End the current session and clear the cookie

get.summary: 204 when the cookie holds a valid session (used by the proxy for the static docs)
Latest sign-in events, newest first
Every active account with its roles, masked client id and which broker secrets are set (never their values)

post.summary: Register a Dhan account (client id, write-only API key and secret, identity, roles and their settings); needs step-up

get.summary: One account with all settings (client id masked; secrets only as set / not set)

delete.summary: Remove an account (archive: history and audit trail are kept); needs step-up

put.summary: Change name, client id, colour and notes; needs step-up
Replace the Dhan API key and/or secret (write-only; omitted values stay) and the key's issue date; needs step-up
Switch roles on or off and set the Data kind (primary or standby); needs step-up

put.summary: Replace the trading configuration (mode, risk profile, capital, styles, instruments, overrides); needs step-up

Save the portfolio settings (default bucket, include in totals, auto refresh off or daily at a time, first import date). When the account is connected, has the Portfolio role and has no holdings, every holding Dhan lists is imported in the same request, dated with the first import date (optional firstImport.rows override dates per key); the settings are saved even when the import fails (import.status failed, import.errorCode portfolio.import_failed). Answer: {account, import} (import always present)

post.summary: Start the Dhan consent sign-in (at most 25 a day): returns the Dhan login page to open in the same tab; Dhan returns to /api/brokers/dhan/callback within 10 minutes; needs step-up

delete.summary: Disconnect: delete the stored access token (local only; Dhan tokens end at their expiry); nothing to do when not connected; needs step-up

get.summary: Audit entries of the account, newest first
The redirect URL to register with the Dhan app: {public base URL}/api/brokers/dhan/callback
Dhan's redirect after the consent login (?tokenId=…): exchanges it for a token and redirects (302) to /accounts?account={id}&connected=1 or &connectError={code}
All risk profiles with the number of accounts that use each

post.summary: Create a risk profile; needs step-up

put.summary: Replace the name and values of a risk profile; needs step-up

delete.summary: Delete a risk profile; refused (409) while an account uses it and for the built-in profiles; needs step-up

get.summary: Buckets to choose from: custom buckets and the default bucket of each account with the Portfolio role
Search the master list: q (symbol, name, ISIN), type, sector, fno, asmGsm, series, tracked (true|false), includeRetired, sort, page, pageSize (max 100)
Counts of the active instruments by type, series, F&O and ASM/GSM, and of the active shares by sector (incl. Unclassified), for the filters; plus how many are tracked
One instrument with all fields and its broker ids

post.summary: Track 1 to 500 instruments (idempotent, all or nothing; a retired one that is not tracked yet is refused with 400 instruments.retired)

delete.summary: Untrack 1 to 500 instruments (idempotent, all or nothing; their history is kept and tracking again continues from it)

post.summary: Look up pasted tickers, canonical symbols or ISINs (up to 5,000, case-insensitive): matched instruments and the unmatched entries (never guessed)
Refresh the master list from Dhan in the background (force: true skips the unchanged-file check); 409 instruments.refresh_running while one runs

get.summary: The refresh in progress (phase, rows read), the last finished one, the daily schedule and the number of active instruments
The most recent refreshes, newest first (take 1 to 100, default 20)
The baskets in the owner's order with their member counts; archived ones only with includeArchived=true

post.summary: Create an empty basket (name, colour, purpose, description); 409 baskets.name_taken when an active basket has the name (ignoring case)

put.summary: Put the baskets in this order: the ids must be every active basket exactly once (400 baskets.invalid), 409 baskets.conflict when baskets changed meanwhile

post.summary: Copy or move up to 500 instruments from one basket to another, atomically and idempotently (only members of the source are transferred; targets are tracked automatically)

put.summary: Replace the name, colour, purpose and description of a basket that is not archived

delete.summary: Archive a basket (idempotent): it leaves the list, its members and history stay readable, instruments stay tracked

get.summary: The members of a basket in their order, with the instrument and its tracked block; asOf=yyyy-MM-dd (India date) gives the members at the end of that day

post.summary: Add 1 to 500 instruments (idempotent, all or nothing); untracked ones are tracked in the same transaction, a retired one that is not tracked is refused (instruments.retired)

delete.summary: Remove 1 to 500 instruments (idempotent, all or nothing); the stay stays in the history, the instruments stay tracked

put.summary: Put the members in this order: the instrumentIds must be every member exactly once (400 baskets.invalid), 409 baskets.conflict when the basket changed meanwhile

get.summary: The newest additions and removals of a basket, newest first (take 1 to 1000, default 200)
The baskets (not archived) that hold the instrument now
Holdings with lots summary, profit/loss and XIRR: accountId, bucketId, status (open default, closed, all), q (symbol, name, ISIN), sort, page, pageSize (max 100)
Totals of the holdings of an account or bucket (all accounts that count in totals when neither is given): invested, value, P&L, XIRR, counts, lots on the default date, last sync
The lots of a holding with the profit/loss and XIRR of each

put.summary: Set the acquisition date of a lot (1990-01-01 to today); the lot stops using the default date

post.summary: Fetch the account's holdings from Dhan for the first import in the portfolio settings, saving nothing; defaultDate (and each row's suggestedDate) is the account's first import date, 2025-01-01 until the owner chooses another

Sync now: bring the holdings in line with Dhan (an account without holdings is imported instead, every holding dated with its first import date and the run recorded as an import; new holdings dated today, quantity changes as lots, sales closed first-in first-out); optional body {confirm, expectedOpenHoldings, expectedWouldClose}; 409 portfolio.sync_running while a sync runs; 409 portfolio.confirmation_required (listedHoldings, openHoldings, wouldClose) when Dhan's answer would close all or most holdings, unless confirm is true with the numbers echoed back; 409 portfolio.confirmation_stale when the answer differs from the confirmed numbers

get.summary: The account's refresh settings (mode, daily time, first import date, hasHoldings), the next scheduled run and the latest sync run

AccountDetail.description:
Everything about one account. Secret values and tokens are never part of it (only set / not set); the client id is masked. ApiKeyIssuedOn and
ApiKeyExpiresOn are the day the Dhan API key was generated and the first day it is no longer valid (12 months). TokenStatus repeats Connection.Status.

AccountEventView.description: One audit entry of an account.

AccountOverrides.description: Per-account replacements for values of the risk profile; null means "use the profile's value".

AccountSummary.description:
One row of the accounts list. Broker is "dhan"; MaskedClientId shows the first four and last two characters; Secrets lists the
secret fields with set / not set; ApiKeyExpiresOn is the first day the Dhan API key is no longer valid; TokenStatus repeats
Connection.Status (for the list's health dot).

AddMembersInput.description: Instruments to add (1 to 500; repeats count once) with an optional note stored on each new membership.

AddMembersResult.description:
What an add did (counts of distinct instruments): `added` became members, `alreadyMembers` were members already, `newlyTracked` of the added
ones were not tracked and are now. `memberCount` = members now.

AutoRefreshView.description: The daily automatic refresh: whether it is on, at what India time, and when it runs next.

BasketHistory.description: The newest additions and removals of a basket, newest first.

BasketHistoryEntry.description: An addition (`kind` = added, `by` = who added it) or removal (`kind` = removed, `by` = who removed it) of an instrument. Only additions carry a note (the one given when adding); a removal has none.

BasketInput.description: Attributes of a basket (create and replace). Missing colour = the default; missing purpose = trading; blank description = none.

BasketMemberView.description:
One stay of an instrument in a basket: `validFrom` = when it was added, `validTo` = when it was removed (null while it is a member),
`position` = place among the members (0 first), `addedBy` = the owner's address.

BasketMembers.description:
The members of a basket, in their order. `asOf` is null for the current members, otherwise the India date they are as of (members at the end of that
day; removed ones show their `validTo`). `total` counts the items.

BasketOrderInput.description: Every active basket exactly once, in the wanted order.

BasketView.description:
A basket. `purpose`: trading · long_term · watch. `position` = place among the active baskets (0 first). `memberCount` = instruments in it now.
`archivedAt` is null for an active basket (archived ones are only listed on request).

BrokerIdView.description: The id a broker uses for the instrument (Dhan: security id + exchange segment).

BucketInput.description: A new custom bucket. The name has 1 to 40 letters, digits, spaces, '_' or '-' and is unique ignoring case.

BucketView.description:
One bucket to pick from. IsAccountDefault is true for the automatic default bucket of an account that has the Portfolio role
(AccountId and AccountName name that account); custom buckets have neither.

ConnectStartView.description: Where to send the owner's browser to sign in at Dhan (same tab): Dhan's consent login page. The sign-in must come back before ExpiresAt.

ConnectionInput.description: New connection details of an account. Leave ClientId out to keep the current client id.

ConnectionView.description:
The account's connection to Dhan. Status is "not_connected", "connected", "expired" (the expiry has passed — derived when read,
no broker call needed). ExpiresAt is when the token stops working (as Dhan states, otherwise 24 hours after sign-in).
BrokerUserName and BrokerUserId (masked like the client id) are what Dhan reported for the token. LastError is a short safe text (at most
Dhan's error code). The token itself is never returned.

CreateAccountInput.description:
A new Dhan account. ClientId and Secrets (API key and secret) are required. ApiKeyIssuedOn is the day the API key was generated
(default today, India time).

DataRoleInput.description: Switch the Data role. Kind ("primary" or "standby") is required when Enabled is true.

DataRoleView.description: Data role of an account: on/off and which kind.

DhanRedirectView.description: The redirect URL to register with the Dhan app, exactly as shown: `{PublicBaseUrl}/api/brokers/dhan/callback`.

FacetCount.description: A filter value and how many active instruments have it.

FirstImportInput.description:
Optional per-holding dates for the first import that happens when the portfolio settings are saved (ADR 0013). Without rows, every holding Dhan lists is
imported dated with the first import date (flagged default-date); a row (key from `holdings/preview`, acquisition date) overrides the date of its holding.
At most 5000 rows. Used only when the account is connected to Dhan and has no holdings yet.

FirstImportView.description:
What a first import did. Status: "imported" (the holdings were created; the counts say how many), "skipped" (the account already has holdings, nothing was
imported), "deferred" (the account is not connected to Dhan, or the Portfolio role is off: the first sync imports every holding, dated FirstImportDate) or
"failed" (the settings were saved but the import was not: ErrorCode is `portfolio.import_failed`, Cause the code of the reason, for example
`portfolio.not_connected`, `portfolio.sync_running`; Message says what to do; save again or press Sync now to retry). Imported counts holdings created, DefaultDated those
among them dated by the first import date, AlreadyImported keys the account had already, Unknown keys Dhan no longer lists.

HoldingLots.description: The lots of a holding, open lots first (oldest first), then closed ones.

HoldingPage.description: One page of holdings (Total counts all matches).

HoldingRow.description:
One holding. Status is "open" or "closed". Mapped is false when the holding is not in the instrument master (InstrumentId and CanonicalSymbol are
then null). LotCount counts open lots; EarliestAcquiredOn is the oldest open lot's date; UsesDefaultDate is true when any open lot has the
import's default date. Returns cover all lots (closed lots add to RealisedPnl and to the XIRR).

HoldingsSummary.description:
Totals over the holdings of the filter (all accounts that count in totals, one account, one bucket). DefaultDateLots counts open lots that
still have the import's default date. UnpricedCount counts open holdings without a usable price: they are left out of Returns (invested, value, P&L, XIRR). ValuationDate is the day the values are as of (today in India).

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. auth.invalid_credentials, auth.locked, auth.session_expired, auth.csrf_invalid, auth.step_up_required, accounts.not_found, accounts.invalid (field errors in "errors"), accounts.conflict, accounts.app_not_configured, accounts.broker_error (502), accounts.connect_mismatch, accounts.consent_limit (429), accounts.connect_expired, accounts.connect_cancelled, portfolio.not_connected, portfolio.sync_running, portfolio.confirmation_required and portfolio.confirmation_stale (409, with listedHoldings, openHoldings and wouldClose), portfolio.conflict (409), portfolio.invalid, portfolio.not_found.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present on auth.locked, auth.rate_limited and accounts.consent_limit: seconds until a new attempt may succeed.

openHoldings.description: Present on portfolio.confirmation_required and portfolio.confirmation_stale: how many holdings the account has open.

listedHoldings.description: Present on portfolio.confirmation_required and portfolio.confirmation_stale: how many holdings Dhan listed.

wouldClose.description: Present on portfolio.confirmation_required: how many of them the sync would close because Dhan no longer lists them.

ImportPreview.description: What Dhan holds for the account, nothing saved. DefaultDate is the account's first import date (2025-01-01 until the owner chooses another).

ImportRowInput.description: One holding to import (a key from the preview). AcquiredOn left out means "use the first import date" (the lot is then flagged).

InstrumentBasketView.description: A basket that holds an instrument now; `since` = when it was added.

InstrumentDetail.description: Everything the master list knows about an instrument.

InstrumentPage.description: One page of search results (`total` counts all matches).

InstrumentSummary.description: A row of the master list. `type`: share · etf · index · future.

LotDateInput.description: Sets the acquisition date of a lot (between 1990-01-01 and today, India).

LotRow.description:
A lot of a holding with its own figures: Invested is its cost, Value is its value now (open) or its sale proceeds (closed), Pnl the difference.
Status is "open" or "closed"; Source "import", "added" or "manual". Estimated: the sale price is the last price a sync saw.

MembersOrderInput.description: Every member of the basket exactly once, in the wanted order.

PortfolioInput.description: The portfolio configuration to change. Every field that is left out (null) keeps the account's current value, on update. DefaultBucket: the name of the bucket imports go to — a custom bucket's name; an empty string "" (or the name of the account's own "{account name} · Portfolio" bucket) selects the account's own default bucket; null or omitted keeps the current choice. IncludeInTotals: true or false; null keeps it. At account creation, omitted means the account's own bucket and true. The automatic holdings refresh: RefreshMode "off" or "daily"; RefreshDailyTimeIst "HH:mm" (India time); left out keeps the current value (a new account: off, 16:00). FirstImportDate (not in the future, not before 1990-01-01) is the date the first import gives holdings without a date of their own. FirstImport is honoured only when updating the portfolio settings of an account (it is ignored at account creation): see FirstImportInput.

PortfolioSaved.description: The answer of saving the portfolio settings: the account as saved and what the first import did (always present; see FirstImportView).

PortfolioSettingsView.description:
Portfolio configuration. DefaultBucket is the name of the bucket imports go to (the account's own default bucket unless a custom bucket was chosen);
AutoBucketName is the name of the account's own default bucket ("{account name} · Portfolio") — the one that exists, or, while the account has none yet,
the name it would get now (with a numeric suffix when the plain name is taken); it is chosen for real when the role is switched on.
The holdings refresh by themselves according to RefreshMode: "off" (default) or "daily" (once a day from RefreshDailyTimeIst, "HH:mm" India time, default 16:00;
the time is kept while the mode is off). FirstImportDate is the date holdings get when they are imported for the first time without a date of their own
(2025-01-01 until the owner chooses another). HasHoldings is true once the account has any holding; the first import has happened then and
FirstImportDate no longer affects existing holdings (ADR 0013).

PreviewRow.description:
A holding Dhan reports, for the first import in the portfolio settings. Key identifies it in the import request (the ISIN, otherwise "securityId:EXCHANGE").
Mapped is false when it is not in the instrument master. AlreadyImported: the account has the holding (open) already.
SuggestedDate is the date to pre-fill: the first import date, or the oldest lot's date of an already imported holding.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code, e.g. auth.invalid_credentials, auth.locked, auth.session_expired, auth.csrf_invalid, auth.step_up_required, accounts.not_found, accounts.invalid (field errors in "errors"), accounts.conflict, accounts.app_not_configured, accounts.broker_error (502), accounts.connect_mismatch, accounts.consent_limit (429), accounts.connect_expired, accounts.connect_cancelled, portfolio.not_connected, portfolio.sync_running, portfolio.confirmation_required and portfolio.confirmation_stale (409, with listedHoldings, openHoldings and wouldClose), portfolio.conflict (409), portfolio.invalid, portfolio.not_found.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Present on auth.locked, auth.rate_limited and accounts.consent_limit: seconds until a new attempt may succeed.

openHoldings.description: Present on portfolio.confirmation_required and portfolio.confirmation_stale: how many holdings the account has open.

listedHoldings.description: Present on portfolio.confirmation_required and portfolio.confirmation_stale: how many holdings Dhan listed.

wouldClose.description: Present on portfolio.confirmation_required: how many of them the sync would close because Dhan no longer lists them.

RefreshRunView.description: One refresh run. `trigger`: manual · daily · forced; `status`: running · succeeded · unchanged · failed; `phase` (while running): downloading · parsing · enriching · saving.

RefreshStarted.description: The refresh that was registered; follow it with `GET /api/instruments/refresh/status`.

RefreshStatusView.description: Where the master list stands: the refresh in progress (if any), the last finished one, the automatic schedule and how many instruments are active.

RemoveMembersInput.description: Instruments to remove from a basket (1 to 500; repeats count once).

RemoveMembersResult.description: What a removal did: `removed` were members, `notMembers` were not. Untracking never happens. `memberCount` = members now.

ResolveInput.description: Pasted tickers, canonical symbols (`NSE:RELIANCE`) or ISINs, up to 5,000 entries.

ResolveResult.description:
The outcome of looking up a pasted list. `entries` counts the non-blank entries, `duplicates` those collapsed because an earlier entry
was the same text or named the same instrument. Entries that match nothing are never guessed: they are listed in `unmatched`.

ResolvedInstrument.description: An entry that named an instrument. `term` is the entry as typed (the first one when several name the same instrument); `tracked` = tracked now; `retired` = cannot be newly tracked.

ReturnsView.description: The profit/loss figures that every holding row, lot row and summary carries.

RiskProfileInput.description: The values of a risk profile to create or to replace an existing one with. Every value is required.

RolesInput.description: Roles to switch; a role that is left out stays as it is.

SecretStatusView.description: Whether one of the owner's Dhan secrets is stored (encrypted) and when it last changed. Name is the request field name ("apiKey", "apiSecret"). The value itself is never returned.

SecretsInput.description:
The Dhan API key and secret, write-only (app_id / app_secret). Surrounding spaces are
removed; the values are stored encrypted and never returned.

csrfToken.description: Must be sent as `X-CSRF-Token` on every state-changing request.

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: The session ends after this long without a request.

expiresAt.description: Absolute end of the session, whatever the activity.

elevatedUntil.description: End of the step-up window (password re-entered); null when the session is not elevated right now.

SessionInfo.description: What the client needs to know about its session.

StartRefreshRequest.description: Starts a refresh. `force` skips the "file unchanged" check.

elevatedUntil.description: End of the window in which sensitive actions are allowed.

SyncInput.description:
Body of "Sync now" (optional). Confirm: true applies an answer that would close all or most open holdings, which is otherwise refused with
`409 portfolio.confirmation_required` (the problem carries `listedHoldings`, `openHoldings` and `wouldClose`). With Confirm: true both
ExpectedOpenHoldings and ExpectedWouldClose are required (400 portfolio.invalid otherwise): the numbers the owner saw in the 409. If Dhan's answer differs
now, nothing is changed and the sync answers `409 portfolio.confirmation_stale` with the fresh numbers.

SyncRunView.description: A run of the holdings sync. Trigger "manual", "auto" or "import"; Status "running", "succeeded", "failed" or "skipped". Error is a short safe text.

SyncStatusView.description:
The refresh settings of an account and its latest run. Mode "off" or "daily"; NextRunAt is null when the mode is off. FirstImportDate is the date holdings
get when they are imported without a date of their own; HasHoldings is true once the account has any holding (the first import has happened). Running is
true while a sync or import of the account is in progress.

TrackResult.description:
What a track call did (all counts are of distinct instruments): `added` never tracked before, `reactivated` tracked again after an
untrack, `alreadyTracked` nothing to do. `totalTracked` is the number tracked now.

TrackingInput.description: Instruments to track or untrack: 1 to 500 ids (duplicates are fine and count once).

TradingInput.description: The complete trading configuration (a replacement, not a patch); whether the role is on is changed with the roles. Mode is "paper" (default) or "manual_live"; CapitalSource is "fixed" (default) or "broker_funds"; Styles holds "intraday" and/or "swing"; allowed instruments: intraday EQ_MIS and FUT, swing buy EQ_CNC and FUT, swing sell FUT.

TradingRoleView.description: Trading role. Mode is "paper" or "manual_live"; Profile is the name of the risk profile (null when none is chosen).

TradingSettingsView.description: Trading configuration. Mode is "paper" or "manual_live", CapitalSource is "fixed" or "broker_funds", Styles holds "intraday" and/or "swing"; instruments are EQ_MIS, EQ_CNC or FUT.

TransferInput.description: Instruments (1 to 500) to copy or move from one basket to another; `mode` = copy · move.

TransferResult.description:
What a transfer did. Only instruments that are members of the source are transferred: the others are `notInSource` (for a repeated move, the ones
moved before). `added` became members of the target, `alreadyInTarget` were there already, `removed` left the source (a move only),
`newlyTracked` of the added ones were not tracked and are now.

UnmatchedEntry.description: An entry that named no instrument. `reason`: `not_found` · `ambiguous` (an ISIN of several instruments) · `invalid` (too long or with control characters).

UntrackResult.description: What an untrack call did: `untracked` were tracked, `notTracked` were not (nothing to do). `totalTracked` is the number tracked now.

UpdateSecretsInput.description:
Replaces the account's API key and/or secret (write-only). A value that is left out stays as it is; an empty one is invalid.
ApiKeyIssuedOn is the day the key was generated: it defaults to today when a new API key is given and can also be corrected on its own.
